executive_summary: Six-year-old Rakesh plants a cherry seed in Mussoorie. Over four years, the sapling survives goats eating its leaves, a grass-cutter's scythe slicing its stem, and harsh Himalayan frost. As pink blossoms appear, Rakesh and his grandfather feel quiet awe, experiencing the miraculous fulfillment of nurturing a living creation.
